description: Aromatic penetration benchmark across monotopic, soluble and query structures
code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
D=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'aromatic_belt.csv'))
col={'monotopic':'#c0392b','soluble FAD':'#2980b9','monotopic flavoprotein':'#e67e22','query':'#27ae60'}
D=D.sort_values('depth_WY')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
a=ax[0]
y=np.arange(len(D)); v=D.depth_WY.fillna(0).values
a.barh(y,v,color=[col[k] for k in D.klass])
for i,(val,k) in enumerate(zip(D.depth_WY.values,D.klass)):
    if np.isnan(val): a.text(0.3,i,'no Trp or Tyr inserted',va='center',fontsize=7,color='#555')
a.set_yticks(y); a.set_yticklabels(D.label,fontsize=7.5)
a.axvspan(14,16,color='#c0392b',alpha=.08)
a.set_xlabel('depth of inserted Trp and Tyr side chains in the best pose (A)')
a.set_title('A. The three monotopic enzymes on lipophilic substrates bury\nTrp and Tyr at 14-15 A; CrtY does not, in either form',fontsize=9)
a=ax[1]
for k in ['monotopic','soluble FAD','monotopic flavoprotein','query']:
    s=D[D.klass==k]
    a.scatter(s.dG_per1000,s.depth_WY,s=90,color=col[k],edgecolor='k',lw=.5,label=k,zorder=3)
for _,r in D.iterrows():
    if not np.isnan(r.depth_WY):
        a.annotate(r.label.split('(')[0].strip()[:22],(r.dG_per1000,r.depth_WY),fontsize=6.5,
                   xytext=(4,-3),textcoords='offset points')
a.set_xlabel('docking score (kcal/mol per 1000 A2)'); a.set_ylabel('depth of inserted Trp and Tyr (A)')
a.legend(fontsize=7); a.set_title('B. Neither axis places CrtY with the monotopic enzymes,\nand the two NDH-2 proteins show the metric is not universal',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(D[['label','klass','dG_per1000','depth_WY','fWY','ins_area']].round(2).to_string(index=False))
